text:
mira: quick follow-up to the safetensors format RFC. ran into a production NaN caused by a shard with an older quant header. thinking: fast header-probe on open + async deep-verify so we fail early and avoid silent corruption. ok?

jon: can you paste the minimal node log? is it dtype/layout mismatch?

mira: short repro from serving node:
```
[2026-06-11T11:02:12Z] load_shard ckpt-42-part2.safetensors: index ok, header=legacy
[2026-06-11T11:02:12Z] WARN loader: dtype mismatch expected=float16 found=quant8
[2026-06-11T11:02:12Z] RuntimeError: GEMM produced NaN at layer=enc-23
```

sasha: two UX choices: 1) probe-on-open (cheap header parse, early failure) or 2) lazy-verify on first exec (delayed). probe-on-open seems better for predictability.

dmitri: for Hosted/Dedicated default probe-on-open. Private deployments get a weight_source flag to opt-out.

mira: minimal API change proposal: WeightSource.open() still returns Reader + metadata map. Add optional string keys: `serializer_id` and `integrity_status` with values: "unknown"|"header_ok"|"header_mismatch"|"deep_ok"|"deep_corrupt". callers that ignore metadata are unaffected.

jon: header schema suggestion: magic(4b), serializer_id, schema_version, epoch, mini_sig (blake2b-64), optional full_checksum_url. mini_sig is fast; full checksum authoritative.

sasha: Console: per-checkpoint integrity badge (green=deep_ok, amber=header_ok/legacy, red=deep_corrupt) and auto-ticket for Dedicated/Private when a live variant flips to red.

ops: ops risk: failing shards on open can cause reload storms. require rollout toggle + canary (sampled probe) and dashboards (`weights.header_mismatch.rate`, `weights.open.latency`).

ci-bot: noted. will add `serializer-roundtrip` CI job: write shard -> header probe -> compute full checksum -> verify deep_ok. hook on serializer repo PRs.

mira: rollout sketch: (1) sampled probe 2-5% traffic, emit metrics; (2) enable for new uploads, mark legacy checkpoints as `legacy` and queue background verify on access; (3) after grace period allow tenant opt-in to block legacy acceptance.

dmitri: runtime behaviour: on header_mismatch -> try compatible fallback (float fallback or older handler) and emit `weights.fallback.attempt`; if fallback fails escalate to error and surface to customer. background verifier will update `integrity_status`.

jon: implementation note: parse only first N bytes on open to extract header; verifier computes/fetches full checksum async and updates metadata. add unit tests that simulate old headers.

sasha: SGTM, i'll draft Console mocks.

mira: i'll file a small RFC patch with header schema, metadata keys, verifier behaviour, runtime reactions + metrics, and rollout + ops toggles. owners: mira (author), jon (loader), sasha (console), ops (rollout). tagging @team-eng-ml for visibility :eyes:
